name: Diablue Login Customizer
author: diablue

sections.description:
Plugin allows admin to upload custom logo for WordPress login page.

After activating the plugin, follow these steps:

  1. Go to Settings -> Custom Login Logo
  2. Click “Choose Image”
  3. Select or upload your logo
  4. Click Save Changes
  5. Refresh the login page to see the new logo
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Go to Settings -> Custom Login Logo
  4. Upload your logo and save
sections.faq:
Where do I change the login logo?

Go to Settings -> Custom Login Logo.

What logo size should I use?

Recommended size: 300px x 100px.
